title: Starfarer (MISC, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Starfarer is a large refuelling ship and gas collector from MISC in Star Citizen, with a crew of up to eight. It is flown from a bridge at the front, with fuel stations and turret seats for the crew. Refuelling other ships is a job for a crew station, not for the pilot.

panels.name: Starfarer: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Starfarer's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Cargo and fuel (291 SCU)
controls.text: The Starfarer holds 291 SCU and has fuel tanks for refuelling other ships.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Starfarer: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Starfarer besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Refuelling station
controls.text: A crew station works the refuelling arm (boom) that gives fuel to other ships.
controls.context: The pilot holds the ship steady while the crew member at this station connects to the other ship.
